scope: Spaces workflow and agent downloads plus context-preserving round trips

checks.fixtures: Public/sample workflow sources and custom profiles; mocked Space/account APIs. Actual browser UI and downloaded ZIPs.

checks.scope: Actual public production client and downloads using controlled sample Space/account API responses. No real private account or Space writes; zero provider calls.

behavior: Structured workflows and agents reuse the central exporter with complete skill resources, original source, manifest and NOT_RUN execution checks.
Saved goal, notes, governing instructions, team, overseer and step configuration survive Space storage and builder reopening.
Text-only items remain explicitly unverified source bundles with BLOCKED execution and no invented SKILL.md or workflow definition.
Malformed or missing selected steps block downloads with persistent feedback.
Unrelated private mind samples do not hitchhike into copied workflows.
limits: Portable files cannot force an external AI host to comply.
Source-only bundles require verification and missing workflow/resources before execution; source privacy and semantic review remain NOT_RUN.
No backend workflow runner or provider compliance evaluation was added.
Finance content release and the combined UI release remain owned by the coordinated publisher; no Git/build/deploy operations were run by this author.

production.scope: Actual public production client and downloads using controlled sample Space/account API responses. No real private account or Space writes; zero provider calls.
